payload.text: **Sweep pre-notice, behaviour changes to call out by name (not just list files):** (1) Every gated tool now reads no input (lib/runlog, 0088 row 2). A gate that prompted at a person's terminal now fails as it does in CI, and a command that needs the terminal must drop log:. The gate exports DEVBIN_GATE_TTY. (2) 0087: --purge, --purge-only and --allow-empty at a command-level gate now reach the gate, not the tool. (3) 0086: a replace of a read-only file no longer blocks at a terminal. (4) 0089: fullcycle without --force asks once at the top after a clean --dry-run preview, and its clean phase always runs --force-blocked --force. New helper ask_person in lib/helpers. (5) release status materialises with git --attr-source, so it needs git 2.40 or later (not measured on CI). Feeds todo 58.
